accounting_quality.headline: Watch

reads.label: Working capital
reads.detail: inventory +52% vs sales +25% — inventory building, demand risk
reads.detail_zh: 存货 +52% 对销售 +25%——存货积压，需求风险

accounting_quality.basis_zh: 多年趋势 + 同业排名
accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+13.0% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +13.0%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

headline.en: Homebuilder volume (revenue) contracting (-4% YoY to ~$113B) — the demand pool for building-products suppliers
headline.zh: 建筑商销量（营收）收缩（同比-4%，约 $113B）——建材供应商的需求来源

read.en: End-market volume is softening while this supplier's estimates still rise — the consensus may be ahead of the end market. Caution.
read.zh: 终端销量走弱，而该供应商预期仍在上修——共识可能领先于终端需求。需谨慎。

caveat.en: COINCIDENT cross-read from 6 homebuilders' annual revenue (FY2025) — an end-market sanity check, NOT a leading indicator (materials book before builder revenue). Display-only; not a buy signal.
caveat.zh: 基于 6 家房屋建筑商年度营收（FY2025）的同步交叉读数——终端需求的合理性检验，并非领先指标（建材入账早于建筑商营收）。仅作展示，非买入信号。

cautions: Narrative basket (Housing Chain) is below its long-term trend — validated drawdown gate: size down (the AI-buildout tape is rewarding leaders, not this one).
cautions_zh: 所属叙事篮子（住房产业链）已跌破长期趋势 — 已验证的回撤门槛：减小仓位。
